lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Are you close? We're meeting at Corner Table at 6:15, right?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Yes, but I'm running late. I'm still on my way—I'm on the bus, but traffic isn't moving.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: I should be there around 6:35. Maybe 6:40. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: That only gives us a few minutes. I'm helping with an evening workshop at 7:00.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Right, I forgot. We don't have to meet at the café. Can we meet at the arts center instead?

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: That works for me. I can stay here. Can you get here by 6:30?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Let me check the route and get back to you in a minute.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: The next stop is on Harbor Street. I'll get off there and walk. I should be at the north entrance in about twenty minutes.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Great. I'll wait here, then. Text me when you're five minutes away.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Okay. Sorry I didn't message sooner.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Thanks for telling me. Please let me know earlier next time.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Got it. I'm heading downstairs now.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Just to check, you mean the north entrance on Harbor Street?

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Exactly—not the main entrance by the parking lot. We can talk in the lobby before my workshop starts.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Got it. Thanks for changing the plan. See you in five.
